description: This file defines a class `ADODB2_generic` which extends `ADODB_DataDict` and provides methods for data type conversion and schema modification SQL generation for a generic database interface. It appears to be part of a database abstraction layer, handling data type mappings and schema alteration commands.

classes.name: ADODB2_generic
classes.description: A class providing database-agnostic data type mapping and schema alteration functionalities.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal meta types to database-specific data types based on the `$meta` parameter.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter a column, not supported in the current implementation.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop a column, not supported in the current implementation.
